name: OpenFEMA NFIP Flood Insurance Claims and Policy Records
size_as_stated: over 2 million property-level claims and 80 million NFIP policy records
access: All NFIP and disaster data are publicly accessible and can be accessed through FEMA’s OpenFEMA portal.

scales.note: OpenFEMA records of property-level claims anonymized at county level across the contiguous US spanning 1978 to 2024.
